source_note: Original AI-assisted community practice path spanning entry, mid, and senior individual-contributor tasks. Each pinned round is a separate practice attempt, not a hiring sequence. Practitioner review and scoring calibration are pending; these exercises do not certify professional or operational competence.
name: Allied Health Practice
blurb: Practice person-centered goals, community handoffs, and automated-summary review.

rounds.title: Therapy Assistant: Hand Over a Changed Participation Goal
rounds.focus: Listen to a person's participation goal and seek a therapist discussion without improvising treatment.

rounds.title: Allied Health Clinician: Review a Community Handoff Gap
rounds.focus: Expose assumed visits and bookings, preserve the person's preferences, and assign the missing confirmations.

rounds.title: Senior Allied Health Clinician: Review an Automated Summary Pilot
rounds.focus: Catch invented functional and support claims and design an evidence-based review of a documentation aid.
